subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the 13-action grouped update land together after workflow-owner review, or should the Codex and privileged release/token updates be separated for narrower validation?
rationale: The PR carries a protected security label and changes externally supplied code in workflows that receive credentials or publish artifacts; deciding the acceptable grouping and validation depth requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Review and land grouped
options.body: Keep the Dependabot batch intact after exact-head checks and focused owner review of the credential, release, security-scanning, and Codex workflows.

options.title: Split sensitive updates
options.body: Separate Codex Action and privileged release/token actions from routine setup and labeling upgrades to reduce the validation and rollback radius.

recommendation.title: Review and land grouped
recommendation.body: Keep the Dependabot batch intact after exact-head checks and focused owner review of the credential, release, security-scanning, and Codex workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person to repository-wide action modernization, Node.js 24 adoption, and the affected Codex and release workflows.
